notes.title: Patch 1.2 16th of April
notes.notes:
New:
- added shake to zombie death
- added red-white blinkig on zombie hit
- added sound to zombie death
Fixed:
- various sound bugs
- lightning bug with splatter on some levels
Changes:
- basic zombies worth doubled
- grenade and launcher have doubled range of explosion
- stronger shake for grenade and launcher

notes.title: Patch 1.1 14th of April
notes.notes:
New:
- added dynamic camera
- added screen shake effects
- added custom blood splatter to all zombies
- added zombie death effect
- added fullscreen mode
- added death screen background (made by jofredeorosz)

Improved:
- doubled projectile speed
